note: campack/ and Paper/ are both real live Java multi-folder worlds (Fabric-modded and vanilla-Paper respectively), staged so tools/phase6/corpus-check.py's rglob finds two distinct real shapes. Only one server's world_slots/ tree can occupy this directory's single 'world_slots' path at a time (the checker assumes one server's worth of slot evidence) -- paper's was chosen since it's MSC 2's primary supported Java flavor and the smaller, cleaner example; campack's equally real world_slots/world.zip evidence exists locally under Cameron's own ~/MinecraftServers/java/campack/world_slots/ and can replace this one if a modded-server slot example is ever needed instead. Neither real world has a `<name>_nether`/`<name>_the_end` sibling directory -- see corpus/worlds/README.md's 'P6.3 real evidence collected' section for why this checker requirement stays unmet even with fresh, real, generated evidence.
